title: Mystical Arbitor of Earth
summary: Defeat the Mystical Arbitor after progressing through the Earthen Badlands’ rings.
overview: Defeat the Mystical Arbitor after progressing through the Earthen Badlands’ rings.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Prepare before the Arbitor appears: it has a fifty-minute hard despawn timer.
Every twelve seconds in combat, it has a chance to wipe its hate list. Tanks should watch for a sudden target change and reclaim it quickly.
After the Arbitor dies, speak with the planar projection for progression credit.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
